information: 本次比賽為 [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) 系列賽事之一，並與 [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/) 合作舉辦。敬請各位參賽者攜帶至少一件未開封的扭計骰或STEM相關物品，有關物品將轉贈予本地機構 [「兒童癌病基金」](https://www.ccf.org.hk/zh-hant/) ，以支持香港兒童癌症病人。詳情請參閱 [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHongKong2026#81539-cube-against-cancer) 分頁。 This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated locally to the [Children's Cancer Foundation (CCF)](https://www.ccf.org.hk/en/) to support pediatric cancer patients in Hong Kong. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHongKong2026#81539-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.
